headline_seed: Magnitude-7.7 quake hits off coast of Indonesia, USGS says - NBC News
draft_text:
#BreakingMews A magnitude-7.7 quake struck off Indonesia's Flores coast at 5:58 a.m. local time Saturday, ~68 km from Ende. BMKG issued a tsunami warning. No casualties confirmed. The Straits Times and NBC News both reporting.

And that's the mews.
